note: Canonical app + field router. categories is identity only (mating/inside/ling/social/economy) — it carries no palette and no colour: each consumer maps a category to its own colour/hat. apps[].fields is the full in-app field extraction, using text / pick / multi / file / group / repeat nodes. Relations are expressed by category and by field/cross paths (e.g. a social app field related to metaphysics), never by colour. Cross relations join fields across apps; consumers list extractive readers such as questy. App tiers are not part of this trunk: the mini/basic/normal/advanced/super variants survive only as demo sketches under apps/blogy/, apps/economy/dealy/, apps/puzzy/keys/ and apps/appy/ (see development/wiki/plans/frontend/apps.md#app-tiers). Flat index: tools/routing-index.json (generated; no colours). Field colours are a separate pending map in development/standards/frontend/routing-colours-db.md.

pending.reason: Core fields are not yet declared here. Some self-contained apps expose their labels in HTML/JS and can be extracted in one pass; others need a small in-app manifest. Add the fields without making the app depend on an external file.
Catalog-only apps without a self-contained HTML source yet. Add the app file and its flove-fields manifest, then run tools/extract-fields.py --apply.
Two concrete links exist (pracsys verbs -> souls system; pracsys subsystem verbs -> souls immune). Add more as apps are audited; do not infer them from colour alone.
Field colours are pending in development/standards/frontend/routing-colours-db.md; routing.json stays colour-free.
